entries.title: Forever Skies

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original Early Access and full-release route, with the best high-end capture/settings flexibility. PS5 launched with the 1.0 release, and Xbox Series X/S is announced for July 27, 2026 alongside The Final Echoes update, but no sourced exclusive content is tied to a console route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version on Steam. Re-check after The Final Echoes update launches on July 27, 2026, because that free update is planned for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Xbox Series X/S release is an announced future port, not a remaster. The Final Echoes is a planned free update, not a separate game entry.
